as_told.title: Fire in the Sky: Hollywood replaced Travis Walton's real abduction

plain: In 1975 an Arizona logger named Travis Walton said he was taken by beings aboard a craft, and his story was later turned into a film called Fire in the Sky. A guest named Chris Ramsay, relaying Walton's own account, says the movie played it out "so differently" from what Walton described. Ramsay notes that the film shows the beings carrying out a procedure on Walton and ignoring his screams. Bryce Zabel, a guest who talks about Hollywood and UFOs, says he heard from the screenwriter Tracy Tormé that the studio decided Walton's real story was not good enough. According to Zabel, they told him "you have to do a better abduction." The tellers bring it up to show how far a film can drift from what a witness actually reported.
